title: Amplifying Consumers' Voice: The Federal Trade Commission's Report Fraud Website Redesign
eligible_reason: Not a staggered DiD. Single-date regression discontinuity in time around the October 2020 ReportFraud website redesign: reg y pre_absds1 pos_absds1 i.dow post if absds<61, absorb(org_cat) on daily complaint counts by FTC channel (online, mobile, call), with BBB/CFPB as placebo series estimated separately (gr_ana_main.do lines 118-152). No unit-specific adoption dates.
design_notes: Stata. RD-in-time with local linear (and polynomial) trends on either side of the redesign date, day-of-week FE, robust SE; Table 4 adds broad-category interactions (post_<g>); Figure 6/8 and Tables 5-8 repeat the RD for text features, topics and keywords.

specs.exclusion_reason: regression discontinuity in time at a single redesign date; no staggered adoption
RD in time with cubic trends and post x category interactions; single date

data_files_note: Daily aggregates by organization/channel shipped; complaint-level data withheld (disclosure).
data_provenance_note: Daily aggregates of original complaint data.
software_notes: Stata; R and Python for text processing
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Single-date RD in time; ineligible on design.
